description: This file defines a custom exception class `GLAccountDisableException` used within the Fineract project to indicate that a General Ledger account cannot be disabled because it is attached to a product.

classes.name: GLAccountDisableException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a GL account cannot be disabled because it is associated with a product.

methods.name: GLAccountDisableException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message and code.

calls: super("error.msg.glaccount.attached.to.product", "General Ledger Account is already attached to product.")
